baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired constructions around iktalu and yastawfun join taking a measure from people to exhaustive completion.
baseline_models.mechanism: The measure is entered from the receiving side: when this group measures for itself against a human counterparty, it drives its own receipt to zero shortfall. The clause is therefore not neutral metrology but acquisition governed by a one-sided completion rule.

activation_trace.role: Measuring out food supplies the quantifying instrument and makes it the gate through which the group receives goods.
Complete fullness without shortfall supplies the endpoint that the receiving party insists on reaching.
Visible human presence supplies the counterparty, making completion a social relation rather than an isolated quantity.

changed_reading.before: They take a measured amount from people.
changed_reading.after: Whenever they occupy the receiving side of measure, they secure the whole due amount for themselves under a one-sided completion rule.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction ala al-nas places completion-seekers in a marked relation to people, while the mapped people-root includes the person-facing side.
baseline_models.mechanism: People are not merely an anonymous market. They become the near, person-facing interface at which the takers orient the measuring system toward their own fullness. The social counterpart is retained in view, but chiefly as the surface that bears the extraction.

activation_trace.role: The near or person-facing side supplies an interface image, casting people as the side toward which the takers turn their acquisition.
The food measure supplies the transactional apparatus positioned at that human interface.
Full completion makes the apparatus terminate at the takers' sufficiency rather than at mutual balance.

changed_reading.before: People are generic customers from whom a quantity is received.
changed_reading.after: People are the person-facing surface of a system oriented toward completing the takers, not toward completing the exchange for both sides.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The measure-root at iktalu also carries comparison between alternatives and one horse matching another in a run.
baseline_models.mechanism: Measuring can be heard as strategic comparison or pacing, not only as filling a vessel. On this branch, the takers benchmark themselves against the people opposite them and continue until their own side reaches the finish condition of fullness.

activation_trace.role: One horse matching another in running supplies a paced contest and recasts measurement as competitive positioning.
Comparing two options supplies deliberate benchmarking within the transactional contest.
Full completion supplies the self-defined finish line toward which the comparison is run.

changed_reading.before: They passively receive an exact quantity.
changed_reading.after: They conduct exchange as a comparison against other people, pacing it until their own side alone reaches full.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next conditional exposes two poles of one measuring system. Receiver-side completion in the focus is paired with measured or weighed delivery that produces shortfall for the other side. Fullness is thus not merely strict self-protection; it is the intake result of a transfer mechanism whose output manufactures loss.

activation_trace.role: Fullness without shortfall supplies the intake state secured for the takers.
Measuring food recurs on delivery and supplies the shared apparatus linking intake to output.
Balancing or aligning two things supplies the comparison axis on which the parties' unequal outcomes become visible.
Causing loss in measure or scale supplies the deficient output deliberately imposed on the counterparty.

structural_cues: 83:2 and 83:3 repeat the conditional idha while reversing who receives and who is measured for.
The branchless ط ف ف cue in 83:1 is used only as the structural heading immediately before this paired mechanism.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies full receipt, repeated measurement, comparison, and loss-making delivery; I connect them as two states of one transfer apparatus. A live alternative is that the verses list two habits without implying that one party's fullness is materially conserved from the other's deficit.

changed_reading.before: They demand full measure when they receive.
changed_reading.after: Their full receipt is the intake pole of a role-sensitive transfer system whose output pole deliberately produces another party's shortfall.

context_deltas.mechanism: Resurrection and collective standing activate the soul-taking and complete-gathering range of the focus completion-root. Those who presently take quantities in full are recast as people who will themselves be stirred, gathered, and made to stand. Agency reverses without requiring yastawfun to mean death directly.

activation_trace.role: Receiving the soul in full supplies a noncommercial completion image in which the present receivers can themselves become received.
Stirring what is still from repose supplies the transition that removes the takers from settled control of the transaction.
Resurrection and the standing of the Hour supply the collective endpoint at which present agency is reversed.
Visible human presence returns the same human collective, now as standing subjects rather than objects beneath the takers.

structural_cues: The resurrection question follows immediately after the two transactional conditionals.
People shift from the object of ala in 83:2 to the grammatical subject who stand in 83:6.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a completion-root branch of whole-person receiving, resurrection, and the same people standing; I infer an agency reversal from takers to taken-and-gathered persons. The alternative is that W-F-Y remains wholly quantitative here and the reversal is only thematic.

changed_reading.before: The takers control a complete receipt from other people.
changed_reading.after: Their complete taking echoes a coming total gathering in which they rejoin those same people as raised and standing subjects.

context_deltas.mechanism: Exact measure gives the act recordable granularity. The marked books and witnessing presence turn a supposedly local extraction into an inscription-producing event: the apparatus that counts every increment for the taker also makes every asymmetry count as evidence.

activation_trace.role: The food measure supplies discrete, countable increments that can leave a determinate trace.
Completion without shortfall supplies the takers' exacting precision, which also makes the act exactly legible.
An inscription that fixes a judgment or decree supplies the conversion of conduct into consequential record.
A written mark in a book or register supplies durable specificity rather than an untraceable private margin.
Presence with direct witnessing supplies an observer for what the marked record makes manifest.

structural_cues: The identical marked-book formula appears in 83:9 and 83:20 around opposed group records.
The focus clause's paired quantitative verbs make its conduct unusually susceptible to exact inscription.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact measurement, consequential inscription, a marked register, and witnessing; I infer that measurable asymmetry becomes what the record can preserve. The alternative is that the books classify persons without encoding this transaction at increment-level resolution.

changed_reading.before: Exactness lets the takers capture otherwise invisible margins in a private exchange.
changed_reading.after: The same exactness makes the extraction self-recording: every captured margin becomes a determinate mark that can place its actor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus already presents people as visible, person-facing counterparts. Later acquisition produces an inescapable overlay on hearts and then blocked access. This supports a perceptual mechanism: repeated self-completing transactions do not merely reduce another's quantity; they train the taker to stop apprehending the human face at the interface.

activation_trace.role: Visible human presence supplies the person who ought to remain perceptible within the transaction.
The person-facing side supplies the exposed relational surface that self-oriented measuring progressively fails to see as human.
An inescapable overlay supplies the cumulative occlusion produced by repeated conduct.
Seeking and obtaining benefit supplies the repeated acquisitive input that forms the overlay.
Prevention of access supplies the mature result of occlusion: a barrier that now acts upon the perceiver.

structural_cues: Ala links the focus relation upon people to the later overlay upon hearts.
The overlay is followed immediately by being barred from access, turning accumulated conduct into changed perception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible people, a person-facing side, acquisitive gain, overlay, and blocked access; I infer that repeated one-sided gain deforms perception of the counterpart. A live alternative is that the overlay arises from denial generally and is not specifically mediated by commerce.

changed_reading.before: The offense is a quantity taken from a fully visible customer.
changed_reading.after: The offense is also a learned occlusion: self-completion converts a visible human counterpart into a mere bearing surface and eventually blocks the taker's own access.

context_deltas.mechanism: The high-overlooking branch of completion and the focus construction upon people permit a provisional vertical reading: full receipt gives the takers a local upper position. The later sequence reallocates height through collective standing, confinement, the elevated record, and looking from couches. Their commercial vantage is real inside the scene but not sovereign over the larger spatial order.

activation_trace.role: Reaching a height and overlooking from it supplies the takers' exploratory image of achieved commercial vantage.
Bodily standing supplies a common level on which all people are repositioned before a higher authority.
Confinement in a holding place supplies the downward or restricted pole of the later spatial ordering.
Elevation and ascent supply the opposed upper pole, showing that height is allocated beyond the market scene.
Directed sight supplies the final privilege of looking from an assigned elevated position.

structural_cues: The focus's ala al-nas is followed by lower and upper record locations and later by ala al-araik with looking.
The same people first placed beneath the takers become the collective that stands in 83:6.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a W-F-Y height image and an explicit lower, upper, and viewing sequence; I infer that commercial upper hand is a temporary vantage later reversed or reassigned. The alternative is that ala is purely transactional and the later vertical imagery is independent.

changed_reading.before: They reach full measure while occupying the advantaged side over a counterpart.
changed_reading.after: Their transaction performs a temporary height over people inside a larger order that can level, confine, elevate, and reassign the viewpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later drink and explicit competition do not simply suppress appetite for fullness. They relocate its object and supply relation. Competitive desire is directed away from making people bear one's completion and toward a precious provision drawn, mixed, and drunk from a spring, where one's reception need not be produced as another person's deficit.

activation_trace.role: Matching another horse in running supplies the focus's latent competitive drive.
Visible human presence supplies the improper substrate from which that drive presently seeks completion.
Complete fullness supplies the appetite retained across the negative and positive scenes.
Slaking a drinker's thirst supplies a positive mode of reception that completes rather than exploits the recipient.
A precious thing for which selves compete explicitly reactivates and redirects the focus's comparative drive.
Mixing one thing with another supplies a compositional fullness whose parts combine rather than transfer loss between people.
A flowing spring supplies an external source for the desired fullness instead of another human being as its bearing surface.

structural_cues: The imperative to compete occurs inside a sequence of being given drink, mixture, spring, and drinking.
The focus directs completion upon people, while the later sequence locates provision in a source from which the near ones drink.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies comparative measure, human counterparty, full reception, explicit competition, and a drink-source sequence; I infer that the sequence reassigns rather than abolishes competitive appetite. The alternative is a broad contrast in objects of desire with no direct rehabilitation of the focus's competitive branch.

changed_reading.before: The clause condemns the desire to secure a full share.
changed_reading.after: It condemns making people the substrate of self-completion; fullness and competition can coexist when their object and supply relation no longer manufacture another's lack.

context_deltas.mechanism: The person-facing interface in the focus expands into a regime of looking, classifying, laughing, returning home, and finally counter-looking. Economic advantage and mockery share a social optic: another person is placed beneath a self-authorizing measure and gaze. The changed subjects of laughter and looking show that neither metric nor viewpoint remains the takers' monopoly.

activation_trace.role: The person-facing side supplies the human interface that can be turned into an object of both extraction and judgment.
The face opening to expose teeth supplies public mockery as a visible performance of social superiority.
Turning a thing away from its face supplies the return movement that carries and reinforces the judging posture at home.
Mutual visibility and facing supply the encounter in which one group claims authority to classify the other.
The same visible laughter with reversed subject supplies the affective reversal of the earlier social vantage.
Things facing so each can see the other supplies a reallocated, reciprocal field of vision rather than a unilateral gaze.

structural_cues: Repeated idha links the focus's transactional habit to later habits of passing, seeing, and reacting.
The branchless غ م ز cue in 83:30 is used only as a structural beat inside the gaze sequence.
Ala returns with the couches from which the final viewers look, reversing who possesses the elevated viewpoint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a person-facing side, repeated looking and laughter with changed subjects, return, and reciprocal facing; I infer one social-optical mechanism spanning extraction and mockery. The alternative is that commerce and ridicule characterize the same class without sharing a causal apparatus.

changed_reading.before: People are counterparties from whom a quantity is secured.
changed_reading.after: People are also targets placed beneath a self-authorizing gaze; the later reversal shows that the takers cannot monopolize either the measure or the viewpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final returned-recompense image closes the focus's apparently one-way receipt into a circuit. Taking in full is not the terminal state of the transaction; once it is also an act, its consequence can return to its actor. Their preferred rule of complete receipt is thus retained but reflexively reassigned.

activation_trace.role: Full completion supplies the one-way endpoint the takers attempt to reserve for themselves.
Recompense returning from an act to its agent supplies the reverse path that closes the circuit.
The production of an act supplies what leaves the actor and becomes eligible to return as consequence.

structural_cues: The surah's final interrogative joins what was done to what was returned as recompense.
Passive recompense makes the former agents into recipients, echoing the agency reversal after the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies full completion, an enacted deed, and recompense returning to its agent; I infer a reflexive circuit in which the takers' acts come back to them. The alternative is that the ending states general requital without specifically echoing the focus's insistence on fullness.

changed_reading.before: They complete a one-way receipt, and the transaction ends at their fullness.
changed_reading.after: Their receipt is only provisionally one-way: what they do enters a return circuit and comes back to the actor as recompense.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the failed-kindling branch of K-Y-L is remote from ordinary measuring, but it is anchored in the exact focus root and activated by the later encounter with blazing fire. Carry it only as branch-induced material irony, never as a direct gloss of iktalu.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The K-Y-L root at the focus measuring verb includes a fire-stick that fails to produce a spark.

activation_trace.role: A kindling-stick failing to spark supplies a materially successful measure that nevertheless fails to ignite recognition.
Encountering fire and its heat supplies the later material contact that reverses the earlier failed ignition.
Blazing, intensely hot fire supplies the fully realized flame against which the failed spark becomes ironic.

changed_reading.after: At a contained material level, the measure succeeds quantitatively but fails to spark moral perception, while the later blaze turns that failure into irony.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the little-human image in the pupil is a distant branch behind the mapped people-root. It remains focus-anchored at al-nas and gains traction from the later mirror, eye, and looking sequence. Render it as a metaphor for self-regarding scale, not as the lexical meaning of people.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The mapped N-W-S people-root at al-nas includes the tiny human figure reflected in the pupil.

activation_trace.role: The little human image in the black of the eye supplies a counterpart miniaturized inside the taker's own field of vision.
View, appearance, and mirror supply the reflective surface through which social scale can be distorted.
The eye as the locus of looking supplies the later reversal of who contains whom within the visual field.

changed_reading.before: People are external counterparties standing at normal social scale.
changed_reading.after: In a contained visual metaphor, the self-filling eye reduces people to tiny reflections within itself until the later reciprocal gaze overturns that scale.

strongest_changes: The paired conditionals revise full receipt into the intake pole of a transfer mechanism that manufactures loss on delivery.
Resurrection shifts people from objects beneath the takers to standing subjects and activates a reversal in which receivers can themselves be wholly received.
Marked records make the exact measuring act self-inscribing rather than privately erasable.
The coating and veil sequence changes quantitative exploitation into a perceptual mechanism that occludes the visible human counterpart.
Later competition for a spring-fed drink reassigns the desire for fullness instead of simply abolishing it.
Returned recompense closes the attempted one-way receipt into a circuit in which action comes back to its actor.
summary.what_was_special: The focus clause remained live as several mechanisms at once: a transfer engine, a person-facing interface, a comparison race, a self-recording metric, a provisional vantage, and a return circuit. Context repeatedly reversed roles without collapsing these readings into one gloss, while also preserving the positive possibility of fullness and competition under a different social relation.
remaining_uncertainties: The whole-person receiving and high-overlooking W-F-Y branches are contextually activated but form-distant from yastawfun.
The record and gaze sequences may characterize the same agents without encoding direct causal consequences of each measured exchange.
The later command to compete may redirect the focus's comparative drive, or it may provide only a broad contrast between desired objects.
The failed-spark and pupil readings remain deliberately contained branch-level outliers rather than lexical proposals.
